LuxNet.why: Vertically integrated optical component maker (InP CW DFB / EML laser chips, OSAs, optical engines) and OEM/ODM transceiver manufacturer whose products serve AI data centers (86.96% of 2025 sales to North America); 800G/1.6T and CW-laser demand for silicon photonics drives its revenue and capacity expansion.
LuxNet.evidence: LuxNet 2025 annual report: OEM/ODM one-stop manufacturing service for data centers covering 100G~1.6T optical engines and CoC packaging; CW DFB laser chips adopted by several major customers; developing 70/100mW CW LD for 800G/1.6T, CPO and silicon photonics.

players.product: InP laser chips (CW DFB, EML) and photodiodes, TO/OSA optical sub-assemblies, 100G-1.6T optical engines and transceivers, and transceiver OEM/ODM manufacturing

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue NT$4,384,846 thousand vs NT$3,451,043 thousand in 2024 (up 27.06%); EPS NT$5.43. Chairman: strong AI data-center demand lifted high-speed optical products and utilisation, giving the best results since the company's TPEx listing. North America NT$3,813,144 thousand (86.96% of sales)
2025 revenue mix: optical active components and modules NT$3,786,274 thousand (86.35%), chips NT$484,378 thousand (11.05%), other NT$114,194 thousand
quarterly_data.figure: active components and modules 86.35% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Customers above 10% of sales (codes only, names not disclosed): LC01082 NT$3,797,512 thousand, 86.61% of 2025 sales (92.08% in 2024); LC20188 NT$453,150 thousand, 10.33%. Largest supplier LV221309 (TOSA sub-modules) 73.63% of 2025 purchases

Products and R&D: completed an 800G ZR module and a 70mW CW LD for DC/DCI; now developing 70/100mW CW LD for 800G/1.6T and CPO / silicon-photonics technology. CW DFB laser chips, co-developed with a strategic partner since 2019, have been adopted by several major customers; extending to 100mW CW DFB and 100G/200G EML-DFB. Provides one-stop OEM/ODM service for data centers covering 100G~1.6T optical engines and CoC packaging; moving InP wafers from 2-inch to 3-inch, with 4-inch planned

Capacity: acquired land and plant on Jilin Road in the Zhongli industrial zone in January 2025 and plans NT$500,000 thousand of total investment in the new plant and equipment at the Hejiang plant to add capacity for optical active components, transceiver modules and sub-modules (chip production and test lines at the old plant, module assembly and test lines at the new plant), paced by long-term customers' expected orders. 2025 capex on plant and machinery NT$444,656 thousand; 2026 planned equipment purchases NT$292,280 thousand
